test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

______ threats to elephants requires public and political will to take action.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. "Addressing".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, **"Addressing" **means dealing with or taking necessary measures to resolve.
 
• Therefore, *"Addressing threats to elephants requires public and political will to take action" ***implies** that in order to tackle or confront the threats facing elephants, there needs to be a desire or determination from the public and political entities.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* '**Addressing** threats to elephants requires public and political will to take action.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the explanations for all the options:
 
 
• **"Dignifying" - **This means to make something seem worthy and impressive. However, it doesn't fit in the context of the sentence as threats are not something you dignify.
 
• **"Perplexing" -** This means causing to be puzzled or bewildered. In this context, it doesn't make sense to say perplexing threats.
 
• **"Stagnating" -** This means ceasing to flow or move; becoming stagnant. Threats to elephants are not stagnant, they are dynamic issues that require active solutions.
